static: A plush chicken has lost half of itself. Help it run through the gate with the matching half.
Change lanes by swiping left or right, or pressing ← → or A D.
Jump over hay bales by swiping up, or pressing ↑, W or Space.
Read the question at the top. Run through the gate with the matching half: complete numbers, words and shapes.
When the WHOLE CHICKEN appears, stay in your lane until the statue passes.
Sometimes the rule flips: in reverse mode, choose a wrong answer.
Hard is free: every run starts with 2 lives, without a wallet or token checks. Each mistake costs one life.

Easy is slower and gives you more time. Unlock it in the Shop: each full million of active timelocked MEMEZZO gives 1 total starting life, with no base lives. Verification happens only when you request it in the Shop; no checks interrupt a run.
Timelock MEMEZZO on DevFridge, then verify here for Easy. Hard is free with 2 lives.
Easy: 1 total life per full million actively locked MEMEZZO. Minimum 1 million; no base lives. Expired locks do not count when verified.

Only manual Shop checks; no automatic checks interrupt play. Easy lasts for this page session. Recheck to update; wallet changes, disconnection or reload clear future access. Ongoing runs continue with their remaining lives.
Tokens stay locked until your chosen expiry, with no early withdrawal.
Redemption includes a 2% fee that buys and burns PASTA. Network fees are separate.
Redeeming MEMEZZO requires an available Jupiter route. New or low-liquidity tokens may lack a route even after expiry.
Locking does not guarantee prizes or price increases.
Wallet and timelock features are for adults. The game reads timelocks; creation and redemption take place on DevFridge, with your wallet approval.
The graphics stopped working. Reload the page to continue.

tutorial.label: Learn by playing
tutorial.safe: No lives lost. No score saved.
tutorial.good: Got it! Ready for the next challenge.
tutorial.done: Ready! Hard mode starts with 2 lives. Visit the optional shop for extra lives and Easy mode.
tutorial.again: No problem! Try the same challenge again.
tutorial.wholeRule: Keep your lane until the statue passes
left: Try it now: swipe left on the track, press ← or A, or tap the left arrow below.
right: Swipe right on the track, press → or D, or tap the right arrow below.
jump: Swipe up on the track, press ↑, W or Space, or tap Jump. Jump over hay bales during a run.
gate: Read the board: half of 8 is 4. Move into the middle lane and pass through the gate marked 4.
reverse: The rule has flipped! Half of 8 is 4, so choose a WRONG answer: move left to 2 or right to 8.
whole: Stop changing lanes until the statue passes. Stay in the lane you started in. Try it now!

access.missing-wallet: Phantom is not available in this browser. On a phone, open the game in the Phantom browser to verify Easy lives in the Shop. Hard needs no wallet.

demo.title: Mezzo Pollo Academy — gameplay demo
demo.description: MezzoPollo: free Hard mode with 2 lives, optional slower Easy mode, interactive tutorial and game interface in 20 languages with 25 regional choices, Italian soundtrack and English song subtitles.
demo.intro: A plush half-chicken runs through three lanes, choosing the missing half of numbers, words and shapes. Dodge obstacles, collect feathers, and stay still when the WHOLE CHICKEN appears.
demo.songTitle: Half a feather, double the flight
demo.songIntro: The complete Italian brainrot theme with English subtitles, generated with Google Lyria in Gemini. In the game it starts with Play, loops at a lower volume, pauses with the run and softens during gameplay cues. Music controls are available in the menu, pause screen and HUD.
demo.captionNote: English subtitles follow the song during playback.
demo.desktopNote: Historical browser walkthrough, recorded on 25 September 2026 before Hard/Easy modes and the interactive tutorial. Its access screens show the old rules. The wallet and lock evidence are simulated; no real wallet approval or transaction is shown. The silent capture shows actual gameplay inputs. Listen to the soundtrack above.
demo.mobileNote: Historical 390 × 844 browser emulation of the English interface, before the current Hard/Easy rules and tutorial, using simulated wallet and lock evidence. Silent capture; not a physical-phone or real-wallet test.
demo.accessIntro: Hard is free and starts every run with 2 lives, without a wallet or token verification. Easy is slower and gives more time: unlock it in the Shop by explicitly verifying at least 1,000,000 MEMEZZO across active DevFridge timelocks of the connected Phantom wallet. No minimum duration applies; expired locks do not count at verification. Mint:
demo.accessOutro: . The /practice route also opens free Hard mode. The interactive tutorial starts before your first play in each language and can be replayed from the menu. Hard and Easy records are local, separate and unverified.
demo.lives: Easy gives one total starting life per full million confirmed in the Shop, with no base lives: 1,000,000 MEMEZZO gives 1 life, 1,999,999 gives 1, and 2,000,000 gives 2. Hard always starts with 2 lives. Starting lives are fixed for each run; resuming or checking the Shop never refills them.
demo.verification: There are no automatic token checks at the start of a run, during play, on resume or when returning to the page. Verified Easy lives remain available for new runs while the page stays open, until a manual Shop check, wallet change, disconnection or page reload. An ongoing run is unaffected. The game reads locks and never asks for transaction signatures; timelock creation takes place externally on DevFridge. Access and lives run in the browser, without server authentication, leaderboards or rewards.
demo.fees: Locks are created and redeemed on DevFridge, with no early withdrawal and a 2% redemption fee for PASTA buy-and-burn, plus network fees. Redemption of MEMEZZO needs an executable Jupiter route. Wallet features are for adults.
demo.submission: . Gallery submission is subject to review; it does not confirm competition eligibility or a prize.
